15: | hour | 0-23 | |

17: | month | 1-12 | `JAN`-`DEC` |
18: | day of week | 0-7, where 0 and 7 are both Sunday | `SUN`-`SAT` |
19: 
20: Names are the first three letters of the English month or day name, in any case. They are
21: only allowed in the month and day-of-week fields. Numbers are plain decimal digits; leading
22: zeros are fine.
23: 
24: Each field is a comma-separated list of one or more items. An item is one of:
25: 
26: - `*`: every value of the field.
27: - `N`: a single value.
28: - `A-B`: every value from A to B. A must not be greater than B, so `22-2` in the hour field raises `ValueError`. In the day-of-week field `6-7` is fine and means Saturday and Sunday.

31:   in the minute field is 0, 15, 30 and 45. `N/S` lists N up to the field's maximum.
32: - Day of month only: `L`, the last day of the month.
33: - Day of week only: `NL`, the last day N of the month (`5L` is the last Friday), and `N#K`,
34:   the K-th day N of the month, where K is 1 to 5 (`1#2` is the second Monday). Here N is a
35:   number from 0 to 7, not a name.
